permits.permit_name: Development Consent Order (DCO) / Transport and Works Act Order (TWAO)
permits.why_needed: Statutory authorisation required for construction of a major highway/road improvement scheme on the Strategic Road Network (SRN) in England. Grants powers of compulsory purchase, street works and changes to traffic regulation.
permits.evidence_required: DCO/TWAO making and confirmation, Order powers certifying possession of land

permits.permit_name: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) / Environmental Statement acceptance
permits.why_needed: Required for larger highway projects; Information for the DCO/TWAO application. Schedules, co-ordinates with Habitats Regulations Assessment (HRA).
required_inputs: EIA Scoping Opinion (DMRB LA 102 / EIA Directive)
Assessment chapters (air, noise, water, ecology, heritage)
permits.evidence_required: Accepted Environmental Statement with Examining Authority confirmation

permits.why_needed: Determines whether the scheme would adversely affect a European/British site (SAC/SPA/SSSI). Required before consent can be granted.
permits.evidence_required: HRA screening / Appropriate Assessment sign-off letter from Competent Authority

permits.permit_name: European Protected Species (EPS) Licence (bats, great crested newts, otters)
permits.why_needed: Undertaking works that may disturb/protect EPS requires a licence from Natural England; precondition for ecology mitigation construction.
permits.responsible_role: Ecology Lead / Ecological Clerk of Works
permits.evidence_required: Natural England EPS licence issued (A10 / CL23)

permits.permit_name: Protected Species surveys: badger, dormice, water voles, reptiles, breeding birds
permits.why_needed: Identify and mitigate impacts on protected species; informs TM / construction phasing and ecology enhancement obligations.
permits.evidence_required: Survey report and mitigation prescriptions accepted by Planning Inspectorate / NE

permits.permit_name: Tree Preservation Order (TPO) and Section 211 Notice
permits.why_needed: Removal/works to TPO-protected trees requires consent from the local planning authority.
permits.evidence_required: Consent to fell / work TPO trees granted

permits.permit_name: Highways Act 1980 — Section 278 / Street Works and Section 184
permits.why_needed: Agreement for highway works within the public highway and connection to the trunk road network; requires National Highways / local highway authority approval.
permits.evidence_required: Signed Section 278 / 184 agreement and approved drawings

permits.permit_name: Compulsory Purchase Order (CPO) / General Vesting Declaration (GVD)
permits.why_needed: Acquiring land required for the scheme (whole or part interests) where not secured by agreement; ancillary to DCO/TWAO powers.
required_inputs: CPO maps and statement of reasons
permits.evidence_required: CPO confirmation and service of Notices to Treat / GVD vesting

permits.permit_name: Traffic Management Act 2004 — Traffic Regulation Order (TRO) / Temporary Traffic Orders
permits.why_needed: Permitted temporary and permanent changes to traffic regulation (speed limits, lane/closure regimes, restrictions) during the works and in the operated scheme.
required_inputs: Works on SRN network management plan
permits.evidence_required: Made/unmade TRO orders and confirmed TM authorisation from National Highways

permits.permit_name: CDM 2015 — Notifiable Project / Appointment of Principal Designer & Principal Contractor
permits.why_needed: Legal duty under the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 to notify HSE and manage health & safety throughout design and construction.
permits.evidence_required: F10 Notice acknowledgement and approved CPP

permits.permit_name: Dangerous Substances / Hazardous Works — Explosives, abnormal loads and non-standard route works
permits.why_needed: Controls for blasting, handling of hazardous substances and movement of abnormal loads on the network during construction.
permits.evidence_required: Permission/notification in force for hazardous activity

permits.permit_name: Environmental Permit / Waste Management Licence (waters, discharges, noise)
permits.why_needed: Controlled waters discharges, site drainage outfalls, waste handling and construction noise beyond threshold may draw Environmental Permitting (England) regulations.
required_inputs: Waste classification and duty of care
permits.evidence_required: Environmental Permit / exemption registered with EA

permits.permit_name: Watercourse / Flood Risk — Land Drainage Act consent and Flood Risk Activity Permit
permits.why_needed: Works in or near main rivers / ordinary watercourses and floodplain require EA / Lead Local Flood Authority consent.
permits.evidence_required: Land Drainage consent / Flood Risk Activity Permit granted

permits.permit_name: Statutory Utility Diversion Consents (gas, water, telecoms, high-voltage)
permits.why_needed: Diversion or protection of existing utility apparatus within the corridor is critical to construction programme; requires consent and sometimes prior notice periods.
permits.evidence_required: Signed diversion agreements and consents from each utility undertaker

permits.why_needed: Works affecting archaeological remains or scheduled monuments require consent under the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Areas Act 1979.
permits.evidence_required: Consent / approval letter from Historic England / LPA

permits.permit_name: Public Notice and Works Consents — street works licence, hoarding and section works
permits.why_needed: Permits for temporary occupation of the street, hoarding, scaffold and other street works under NRSWA and the Highways Act.

permits.permit_name: Landfill / Disposal Authority consent for construction waste
permits.why_needed: Disposal of surplus material (e.g. excavated spoil, contaminated arisings) to an authorised facility with duty of care compliant documentation.
permits.evidence_required: Registered disposal consents and waste transfer notes

permits.permit_name: Temporary Works / Design and permanent schemes consent by National Highways (Road Investment Strategy)
permits.why_needed: The scheme must be accepted into the Road Investment Strategy (RIS) pipeline and comply with National Highways' Sector Deal / Route Strategies; overarching approval for delivery.
permits.evidence_required: RIS entry and approvals to gate release funding
